document.abstract: (1.1) This standard specifies the dimensions of two types of 16-tooth intermittent sprockets for 35-mm motion-picture projectors. Other dimensions and definitions are given in annex A. (1.2) This standard is applicable to sprockets used in conjunction with film perforated in accordance with ANSI/SMPTE 139 (0.1870 in pitch) or SMPTE 102.
